claim: TISMO Tacstd2 up in 49/64 ICB comparisons, p=5.8e-5
note: 49/64 is exactly the TISMO gene-module ICB-vs-baseline direction count for Tacstd2. p=5.8e-5 matches Wilcoxon signed-rank on the 64 mean differences, not the two-sided binomial (2.4e-5). Cldn4 is not directionally consistent. Lung-only is 2 LLC groups, both up.
